name: Sidney Fine
bio: a Representative from New York; born in New York City, September 14, 1903; attended public schools; graduated from College of the City of New York in 1923 and from the law school of Columbia University in 1926; admitted to the bar in 1926 and commenced practice in New York City; member of the New York state assembly in 1945 and 1946 and the New York state senate 1947-1950; elected as a Democrat to the Eighty-second, Eighty-third, and Eighty-fourth Congresses and served from January 3, 1951, until his resignation January 2, 1956; New York State Supreme Court, 1956-1975; resided in New York City until his death there on April 23, 1982; interment at Old Montefiore Cemetery, Queens, N.Y.
